name: RC Rocket
description: Performance tuning built around Divi. Asset control, media delivery, JavaScript timing and a safety net that switches itself off when something breaks.
changelog:
0.12.0 — Fixes from a full review before rolling out to every site: hardened error and hero-image beacons, HTTPS-only updates, typed settings import, opt-in database cleanup, page-cache fixes (WP Rocket takeover, path normalisation, Divi Theme Builder purges), safer script delay and lazy loading.
0.11.3 — Fixes from speed testing: scripts called by inline snippets, menu and form plugins are never delayed.
0.11.2 — Diagnostics for jQuery loading, richer error reports, Kinsta cache bypass explanations.
0.11.1 — Fixes from a full code review: Divi builder Heartbeat, local Google Fonts for Divi, XML-RPC off by default.
0.11.0 — Automatic hero (LCP) detection, lazy Divi background images, WordPress Abilities / MCP tools.
0.10.0 — Kinsta single-page purge, per-row Clear cache links, more ignored tracking parameters.
0.9.0 — Per-page options in the editor sidebar.
0.6.4 — Fixed the Plugin Details modal showing a blank description or a stale version number when the cached update-check result predates a plugin update.
0.6.3 — Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
0.6.2 — Plugin URI updated to rhythmco.com. The update manifest can now supply its own description for the Plugin Details modal instead of a hardcoded one.
0.6.1 — GitHub Actions release workflow. Tagging a version lints every file, runs all nine test suites, builds the admin app and attaches the zip to the release.
0.6.0 — Self-hosted updates. Define RC_ROCKET_UPDATE_URL in wp-config.php and every site sees new releases in Dashboard > Updates.
